source_caption_text:
When she says raindrops is her favorite sound to fall asleep to, so I play this 

Travis Scott’s “Raindrops (Insane)” has that dark, late-night sound that pulls you in almost immediately. Released on Metro Boomin’s 2022 album HEROES & VILLAINS, the track is built around a moody synth melody, heavy 808s, and Travis’ unmistakable melodic delivery. Metro keeps the production simple but atmospheric, giving Travis plenty of room to take over the song.
 
Travis floats over the beat with his signature Auto-Tuned vocals, turning the “dodging raindrops” idea into a catchy hook that sticks in your head. The whole track has this smooth but slightly chaotic feeling, with the production and vocals creating the perfect soundtrack for a late-night drive or just zoning out with your headphones on.

Even years later, “Raindrops (Insane)” still has that instantly recognizable Travis and Metro sound. It’s one of those tracks where the beat comes in and you already know what’s about to happen. The combination of Metro’s production and Travis’ vocals makes it a song that can fit almost any late-night mood.

#travisscott #rap #meme
